verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API development and testing client (REST, GraphQL and WebSocket requests, collections, CLI). Routing, load-balancing and transforming live traffic between consumers and upstream services is an API-gateway function outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships gateway or proxy traffic-management capabilities. Its interceptor and agent only relay the user's own test requests.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can route, load-balance, and transform requests between consumers and upstream services
